Rules / Tool

SK9015 The file could not be read or written

An I/O failure, not a formatting one: the file was not inspected and was left exactly as it was, so it is not covered by this report.

CategoryTool
Default severityerror
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

A file the tool could not open is a hole in the run, and a hole that says nothing is indistinguishable from a clean file. It is an error rather than a warning because format, arrange and verify all exit InternalError on it, and the report has to agree with the exit code.

When it does not fire

None; it reports an IOException that happened. The usual causes are a permission denied, a file another process holds open, and a read-only working tree.
